Reliance and bp announce full ramp-up of MJ deepwater gas field in KG D6 offshore block

September 29, 2026

Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) and bp today announced that the MJ deepwater gas field in block KG D6 has reached peak daily production of 30 MMSCMD, representing one-third of India's domestic gas output.
